label: prf:q-dilogarithm-exists
title: Proof of existence of the $q$-dilogarithm
html: The shuffle recursion \Delta_q(p_k) = p_k \otimes 1 + 1 \otimes p_k + \sum_{i=1}^{k-1} p_i \otimes p_{k-i} with p_0 = 1, p_1 = \log_q has a one-dimensional solution space at each level (up to lower-level primitives). Choosing the normalisation fixed by the pentagon identity uniquely determines \mathrm{Li}_2^q as a specific element at level k = 2. Over \mathbb{C} this recovers the convergent series \sum x^n / (n [n]_q) on |x| < 1. Over \mathbb{F}_p, \mathbb{Q}_p, \mathbb{C}_p the same shuffle recursion applies with truncation / convergence-radius adjustments as in the (q-dilogarithm) three-context section.
